characterBible.prompt: Create an ORIGINAL four-column full-body CHARACTER MODEL SHEET for a hand-drawn children's picture book, ages 7–9. PURE WHITE paper background; no scenery, letters, labels, logos or props. Four equal-width separated columns, full bodies and shoes in frame, common baseline. LEFT two columns: SAME BOY age8 front and three-quarter. RIGHT two columns: SAME FATHER age38 front and three-quarter. Boy is conspicuously TALL and LANKY, about 75 percent of father's height. His face is LONG and narrow with angular chin, LARGE protruding ears, a long gently pointed nose, thin arched eyebrows and SMALL horizontal almond-shaped eyes behind VIOLET RECTANGULAR glasses. Short BLACK bristly FLAT-TOP crew cut, NO fringe, bowl cut, soft curls or bangs. Light warm beige skin, no pink round doll cheeks. ULTRAMARINE blue short-sleeved polo shirt with narrow pale-yellow collar and sleeve trim, stone-grey knee-length shorts, tall white socks, pale-yellow sneakers. Father is WIDE-SHOULDERED and stocky, broader than the lanky boy; broad trapezoid face, heavy eyebrows, a large rounded nose, short DARK wavy hair, short square beard, no glasses. Dusty coral short-sleeved T-shirt, warm grey trousers, navy canvas shoes. Child five heads tall, adult seven; tiny expressive eyes and changing mouth shapes, natural hands. Loose lively GRAPHITE pencil with rhythmic angular contours and sparse hatching, FLAT dry colored-pencil accents, abundant white paper, contemporary warm literary illustration. NOT chibi, huge sparkling eyes, rounded baby face, anime, 3D, glossy rendering or photorealism. Character distinction must come from facial structure, ear and nose shapes, age and body silhouette as well as color. Empty relaxed hands.
